purpose: Quick power verification at single cell to confirm N=6 amendment is adequately powered
method: 25 runs, paired permutation test with 500 perms, N=6 paired comparisons, Δβ=-0.5 (matches Reading 06 §10.3 effect size lower bound for clean discrimination)
interpretation: Power = 100% at N=6 with Δβ=-0.5 — confirms the confounds.md §1 amendment (N=3 → N=6) is adequately powered. The original N=3 protocol had max achievable p = 0.125 by construction (1/8 permutation ceiling); N=6 has max p = 0.016 (1/64) and reaches it reliably at effect sizes ≥ 0.3.
full_grid_note: Full power grid (N ∈ {3, 6, 9, 12} × Δβ ∈ {-0.1, -0.2, -0.3, -0.5, -0.7, -1.0}) requires ~10-15 min wall-time. Run on local machine via: python3 pilot.py --mode power --seed 2026
discipline_note: Pre-registration discipline preserved: amendment locked 2026-06-02 BEFORE any GDELT data examined. Power verification done on synthetic ground-truth-known signals only.
